paragraphs.source_en: Princess Sena fell silent as though turned to stone. At last she understood Ishikawa Kazumasa’s meaning. The attack on Udono Nagateru at Nishikōri Castle was Motoyasu’s agonizing stratagem to save her and Takechiyo. As a stratagem, the attack was indeed enough to make Ujizane reconsider. To Ujizane, Shinchirō and Tōshirō, the two sons of Udono Nagateru, a meritorious retainer of the Imagawa, were indeed worth exchanging for Princess Sena and her children.

paragraphs.source_en: “By then my lord will surely march on Sunpu with Udono’s two sons in custody…” Kazumasa declared categorically, though inwardly his heart trembled. When he left Okazaki Castle, he had never imagined that Nishikōri Castle would fall so quickly.

paragraphs.source_en: Before Ishikawa Kazumasa departed, Motoyasu had already advanced with the main force to Mount Natori and ordered Matsudaira Sakon Tadatsugu and Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami Toshikatsu to attack Nishikōri.

units.source_zh: 石川数正出发之前，元康已经率领主力推进到名取山，并要松平左近忠次和久松佐渡守俊胜攻打西郡。

paragraphs.source_zh: 石川数正出发之前，元康已经率领主力推进到名取山，并要松平左近忠次和久松佐渡守俊胜攻打西郡。

paragraphs.source_en: Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami Toshikatsu was the husband of Odai, Motoyasu’s birth mother, and under the agreement with Nobunaga he had remained to guard Agui Castle. For this campaign he personally led his eldest son Saburōtarō and brought his forces to support Motoyasu. It seemed that Motoyasu meant to rely on kin to rescue kin.

paragraphs.source_zh: 久松佐渡守俊胜是元康亲生母亲於大的丈夫，根据和信长之间的协议，他继续留守阿古居城。这次出征，他亲自带领长子三郎太郎率军呼应元康。元康似乎想依靠亲人去营救亲人。

paragraphs.source_en: In this battle, Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami and his son fought with great valor, while Matsudaira Sakon Tadatsugu’s stratagem achieved unexpected success. Tadatsugu brought many Iga ninja into the battle. He sent eighteen men ahead to infiltrate the castle, including Ban Chūsho and Ban Tarōzaemon of Iga and Tara Shirō Mitsutoshi of Kōga; when the troops outside attacked, they were to set fires within in concert with them.

units.source_en: In this battle, Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami and his son fought with great valor, while Matsudaira Sakon Tadatsugu’s stratagem achieved unexpected success.

paragraphs.source_zh: 此战，久松佐渡守父子英勇奋战，松平左近忠次的策略也取得了意想不到的成功。忠次让许多伊贺忍者加入战斗。他派伊贺的伴中书、伴太郎左卫门，甲贺的多罗四郎光俊一行十八人先行潜入城内，待城外的部队进攻时，从内放火，以相呼应。

paragraphs.source_en: The Udono forces immediately fell into confusion, mistakenly believing that a mutiny had broken out in their ranks. Udono Nagateru, arriving from Sunpu, did not dare enter the castle and fled straight toward Mount Natori, where on the way he even mistook Motoyasu’s troops for his own. After Nagateru and his younger brother were killed, the survivors collapsed into a rout. In a single night, Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami captured Nishikōri Castle, and Nagateru’s two children became prisoners.

paragraphs.source_en: Kazumasa learned the news on the road, and his anxious heart at last eased, only for a new unease to rise: they now had hostages to exchange, but could he reach Sunpu before Ujizane killed Takechiyo and his mother? Fortunately, Kazumasa reached Sunpu at the critical instant when Princess Sena was about to kill Okame with her own hand.

paragraphs.source_en: At the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Hare, Kazumasa opened his eyes. Deliberately leaving his hair unbound and his beard unshaven so that he looked exhausted from travel, he took a drink of water and left the room.

paragraphs.source_en: A tall viewing platform had been erected in the garden, and the ground beneath it lay in disorder, plainly bearing the traces of the previous night’s song and dance. Ujizane was still asleep. If roused from a sound sleep, he would remain irritable all day, so his personal guards never dared wake him rashly. So much the better, Kazumasa thought.
